pages.title: Ball Race
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description:
Ball Race puts you in control of a rolling ball on obstacle-filled tracks, with rival balls racing alongside you. Guide your ball through each course while trying to stay ahead of the competition. Progress through levels, improve your ball, and change its appearance with skins as you work toward a higher place on the leaderboard.

The challenge is to handle the course without letting the other balls overtake you. Watch the track ahead so you can prepare for obstacles while maintaining your lead.

pages.title: Geometry Vibes 2 Online
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Guide an arrow through geometric obstacles in Geometry Vibes 2 Online. Time each change in direction to get through narrow gaps and finish the courses. Try the revamped Infinity Mode for a longer run, customize the arrow, or take on other players in an online race.

pages.title: Food Jam
pages.creator: Yesbol Amirov
pages.description: Fill customer orders in Food Jam by sorting ingredients into groups of three. Check what the kitchen needs before moving items to your tray, since its space is limited. Keep matching and serving to get through each level and unlock more foods along the way.

pages.title: Breakthrough Team
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build defenses and send heroes into battle in Breakthrough Team. Position your team to handle the enemies coming in waves, then use the heroes’ different abilities to push back. Watch how each attack develops so you can see where the defenses need more support.

pages.title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Equip three arrows in Archers Ragdoll Physics and switch between them in battle. Choose from effects such as fire, lightning, or poison, and use a shot to trigger traps like spinning gears on some levels. In two-player mode, aim to land more hits than your opponent.

pages.title: Cute cat's adventures
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help a cat find three kittens in each level of Cute cat's adventures. Explore the paths for coins and secrets, and watch for traps or enemies while you search. Check the parts of the level you haven’t visited yet if you’re still missing a kitten.

pages.title: Super Brain
pages.creator: XMetaGame
pages.description: Answer questions by choosing a lane in Super Brain. Read the question at each gate and steer toward the correct answer before reaching it. A wrong choice ends the run, and the faster you get, the less time you have to work out the trickier answers.

pages.title: Math Box Balance
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Balance the totals in Math Box Balance by swapping numbered blocks between boxes. Each box holds four numbers and displays their sum, so use those totals to decide what to trade. Start with two boxes and work up to layouts with as many as eight.

pages.title: Geometrix
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Change your shape to match approaching enemies in Geometrix. A collision destroys the enemy when both shapes match and costs you health when they differ. Get used to switching quickly as more shapes enter play across over 40 levels.

pages.title: Egg Adventure 2
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Help Mr Egg find the exit in Egg Adventure 2. Look at what each room gives you, then try the action that might open the door. Some solutions depend on what a word means, while others ask you to do something unexpected with the eggs.

pages.title: Toy Cars: 3D Racing
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Race rivals and take on timed challenges in Toy Cars: 3D Racing. Drift through turns and use the garage to improve your car between events. Upgrade the engine, tires, or chassis depending on which part of the car you want to improve for the next race.

pages.title: Puzzle Box Brain Fun
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Switch between puzzle types in Puzzle Box Brain Fun. Drag pieces into place, look for hidden objects, or collect items by finding their matches. Each mode asks you to pay attention to something different, and new challenges open up as you finish levels.

pages.title: Murder Case Clue 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Investigate a murder in Murder Case Clue 3D. Search the house as a detective, looking for clues that can help you work out a way to escape. Check the rooms carefully and stay alert as you move through the dangerous building.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Haunted Dorm
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Get inside before the captor arrives in Skibidi Toilet Haunted Dorm. Once you’re in your room, improve the weapons that protect it and hold off the attacker. Watch the entrance while you build up your defenses, because a successful break-in ends the game.

pages.title: Stickman Broken Bones io
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Run, jump, and rack up damage in Stickman Broken Bones io. The stickman’s ragdoll movement makes each fall play out differently, and bigger crashes earn more points. Use the shop to improve the stickman or his transport, then try for a better leaderboard score.

pages.title: Scary Granny Games Ghost Games
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Find a way out of a locked house in Scary Granny Games Ghost Games. Move with WASD and look around the rooms for a way to escape. Stay alert for Granny as you explore, because she’s the one keeping you inside.

pages.title: The Elevator Clicker
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Help Mr. D get home from work in The Elevator Clicker. Press the elevator button and buy upgrades that make his finger stronger or let you press faster. Keep building up your clicking power until the elevator arrives and you can see how his wait ends.

pages.title: Stack Runner Short Path Racing
pages.creator: GamingStars
pages.description: Gather boards as you race in Stack Runner Short Path Racing. Build up your stack, then look for places where you can use the boards to lay a bridge and cut across the course. Decide where a shortcut can save you time before you spend the boards you’ve collected.

pages.title: Police Car Armored
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: Patrol the city in Police Car Armored and use your vehicle to go after criminals. Find them around the city, catch them, and bring them back to the police station. Successful trips earn rewards before you head back out to look for the next suspect.

pages.title: Biker Battle 3D
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Fight from the seat of a motorcycle in Biker Battle 3D. Attack riders to either side or in front while staying on the road. Collect gold during the highway missions and put it toward weapons, abilities, skins, or a different chopper for your next ride.

pages.title: Lovely Streamers
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style streamers for their broadcasts in Lovely Streamers. Try bright outfits and multicolored hairstyles, then pick accessories that suit each look. Put the pieces together the way you want and give each streamer a style of her own before she goes live.

pages.title: Toy Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Put together pictures of toy cars in Toy Car Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into place and choose from three difficulty settings for each image. The harder mode pays more in-game money, which you can put toward unlocking the other pictures in the ten-image collection.

pages.title: Street Mayhem - Beat Em Up
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight through city streets, a forest, and a castle in Street Mayhem - Beat Em Up. Join Edward, Jennifer, and Russell against gangs and mutants in the story. For a separate challenge, take on a friend and try to win three rounds in the two-player mode.

pages.title: Bullet Car
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Outrun robotic pursuers in Bullet Car by switching between car and bullet with Space. Stay in car form when you land, then turn into a bullet to smash through gates or gain speed uphill. Pick up gas canisters and nitrous bottles to keep your chain going through the wasteland.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pro
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Shoot matching bubbles to clear the board in Bubble Shooter Pro. Add your shot to at least two bubbles of the same color to pop the group. Shots that clear nothing count as fouls, and after enough fouls a new row appears, so try to make each shot count.

pages.title: Stone Smacker
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Push stones into holes in Stone Smacker to open a route to the treasure chest. Look at where each stone can move before you push it so you can reach the rest of the puzzle. Find the chests to help the young hero’s village.

pages.title: VINT
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Reverse the rotation of two balls in VINT. Tap or click to change direction and line them up to collect white pieces while steering clear of dark ones. Watch what’s about to cross their path and time the next reversal to keep the run going.

pages.title: Rotate
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Turn the outline to keep a ball away from spikes in Rotate. Choose a circle, triangle, square, or hexagon, then spin it left or right as the ball moves inside. Pick up diamonds and watch for extras such as protection or an extra life.

pages.title: Christmas 2020 Spot Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Find five differences between each pair of pictures in Christmas 2020 Spot Differences. The timer keeps running while you search, and finding the changes quickly earns a higher score. Use a hint if you’re stuck and keep going through all 15 holiday levels.

pages.title: Whack the Dummy
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Try different ways to hit a training dummy in Whack the Dummy. Use melee weapons, guns, explosives, or sillier items to see what happens. Open chests to unlock more equipment and look out for outfits you can put on the dummy.

pages.title: Adorable Fish Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Flip cards to find matching fish in Adorable Fish Memory. Remember which fish were on cards you’ve already turned over so you can find their partners later. Play through four levels and try to clear each layout without spending extra moves on the same cards.

pages.title: Pirate Islands Nonograms
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Solve nonograms to look for buried treasure in Pirate Islands Nonograms. Use the numbers around each grid to work out which squares to fill. Aim for three stars as you travel between islands and build collections, and look through picture albums for rarer items that help you continue.

pages.title: Summer Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Match pairs of summer-themed tiles in Summer Mahjong. Look for two matching designs you can remove now, then use the space they leave to reach other tiles. Keep working through the layout until the board is clear.

pages.title: City Coach Bus Parking Adventure Simulator 2020
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Drive a coach through bus parking challenges in City Coach Bus Parking Adventure Simulator 2020. Line up the bus before entering the space, and leave room to turn as you move through each lot. Take the larger vehicle through the courses and practice getting it into position.

pages.title: Girls and Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six pictures in Girls and Cars Puzzle and put it back together. Set the difficulty to 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the outlines and colors to find where neighboring pieces fit, then try another image or a finer cut.

pages.title: Save The Coal Miner
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Get miners safely onto the ground in Save The Coal Miner. Remove boxes and other obstacles in an order that lets each miner descend without touching dynamite. Pick up an extra life when you can, or use the option to skip a level that’s holding up your progress.

pages.title: Heavy City Coach Bus Simulator Game 2k20
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive passengers from city to city in Heavy City Coach Bus Simulator Game 2k20. Take control of a coach and follow the route through different driving scenarios. Keep the bus under control as you work toward the destination and complete the trip with your passengers.

pages.title: Color Pong
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Keep the rally going in Color Pong by hitting the ball with a circle of the same color. The ball can change color between hits, so switch circles when you see what’s coming back. Make each match in time and see how long you can keep the ball in play.

pages.title: My Valentine Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Line up three or more identical Valentine items in My Valentine Match 3. Each match helps build your score, but keep an eye on the meter at the left of the board. If it gets too low the game ends, so keep looking for the next group to clear.

pages.title: Old Timer Cars Coloring
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Choose one of eight vintage car pictures in Old Timer Cars Coloring. Use the 23-color palette to color the bodywork and other details, or work quickly to try for a higher score. Save a finished picture when you want to keep your design.

pages.title: Battleships Armada
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Place your fleet and search for the computer’s ships in Battleships Armada. Take shots at squares on the opposing grid, then use any hits to narrow down where the rest of a ship could be. Sink the opposing fleet before the computer finds and sinks yours.

pages.title: Quiz Kingdoms
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Answer a mix of questions in Quiz Kingdoms. Work out the numbers when a math problem appears and decide whether a statement is true or false when the format changes. Read each prompt carefully before choosing your answer, because the next one can test something different.

pages.title: LOL Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Make a custom doll in LOL Dress Up. Choose her clothes and accessories, then adjust details such as eye color to give her a look of her own. Try different combinations in the avatar maker until the outfit and features fit the style you want.

pages.title: RX7 Drift 3D
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Take a third-generation Mazda RX-7 for a drive in RX7 Drift 3D. Explore the open city and practice getting the rotary-powered car sideways through turns. Try a different set of wheels or change the suspension before taking it out for another run.

pages.title: Halloween Mask Coloring Book
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Color eight mask designs in Halloween Mask Coloring Book. Pick shades from a palette of 23 colors and fill in the details, or see how fast you can finish to improve your score. Use the save option to keep a copy of a mask you like.

pages.title: Chicken and Crow Shoot
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take on bird-hunting missions in Chicken and Crow Shoot. Look for crows and line up your shot from a first-person view. Try the pistol or the sniper rifle as you track your targets and work through the shooting challenges.

pages.title: Cartoons coloring
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Pick a drawing and fill it with your own colors in Cartoons coloring. Try different shades for the characters and the details around them, then see how they look together on the page. Move to another picture when you’re ready to try a new set of colors.

pages.title: Extreme FootGolf Evolution
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Kick a soccer ball toward golf holes in Extreme FootGolf Evolution. Choose where to send the ball based on the layout, then work around the unusual obstacles on the course. There are 24 holes, with a different route to figure out as you move through them.

pages.title: Baby Hazel In Preschool
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Baby Hazel get ready for her first day in Baby Hazel In Preschool. She’d rather keep playing, so get her set for school and follow her into the classroom. Help Hazel and the other children through their activities as their needs come up.

pages.title: Car vs Zombies
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive through the undead in Car vs Zombies. Steer left or right to line up with zombies in your path as you travel farther down the route. The game tracks kills and distance, so see how many zombies you can hit while trying to beat your longest run.

pages.title: Shark Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Put together ten shark pictures in Shark Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into place and choose from three difficulty settings for each image. Harder puzzles earn more in-game money, which you can save up to buy access to another picture.

pages.title: A1 Citycarver Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures of the A1 Citycarver in A1 Citycarver Puzzle. Pick a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece version of each image. Use the car’s outline, the angles of its bodywork, and the background to work out where the pieces fit.

pages.title: Toy Car Simulator
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Take toy vehicles for a drive in Toy Car Simulator. Explore the streets in Free Ride, weave around traffic on the Highway, or try to outlast the other vehicles in the Arena. Collect coins and try different rides as you switch between the three modes.

pages.title: Airplanes Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six aircraft pictures in Airplanes Puzzle 2. Each picture can be split into 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look for features such as the edge of a wing or a change in the sky to see which pieces go together.

pages.title: Twist Hit!
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Grow trees by filling rings in Twist Hit! Press and hold to add to the ring, then release when an obstacle moves into your path. Time when you start filling again so you can finish the tree without hitting anything and move on to the next one.

pages.title: EG Wind Mill
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Turn the windmill to catch each bag in EG Wind Mill. Match the color of the bag to the section of the mill it’s headed toward, and get the next color ready when the bag changes. The bags come faster over time, leaving less room to correct a mistake.

pages.title: Hoppy Stacky
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Jump onto sliding platforms in Hoppy Stacky. Watch the next platform move toward you and time your jump so you land on top of it. Keep climbing as more platforms slide in, and collect coins when you can reach them without missing a landing.

pages.title: Break The Hoops
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Rotate the hoops beneath a bouncing ball in Break The Hoops. Guide the ball onto breakable sections and keep it clear of the spikes as the ring turns. Finish breaking the hoop to move on, and try different balls as you work through the game.

pages.title: Buddy Toss
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Tap to throw a man into the air in Buddy Toss. Watch his fall and tap again just before he drops past the lifter’s arms. Each successful toss sends him higher, so keep changing your timing as the gap between throws grows.

pages.title: Fish Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a fish picture in Fish Coloring Book and color it with the brush. Pick the shades you want for the fish and its surroundings, and change them as you move between parts of the drawing. Try a new palette when you move to another image.

pages.title: Land vs Sea Moana vs Elsa
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Moana and Elsa put together outfits in Land vs Sea Moana vs Elsa. Their friendly competition is about dressing for two different themes, land and sea. Browse the clothes for both characters and pick pieces that fit the theme you want each outfit to express.

pages.title: Mask Lady Sky Time
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Marinette get ready for the snowy mountains in Mask Lady Sky Time. Choose a winter look and get her set up for skiing, then join her on the slopes. The game takes her from getting ready to spending time out in the snow.

pages.title: Square Jump
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Time each jump to get a square past spikes in Square Jump. Keep watching the ground as it runs forward, and jump when the next hazard is close enough to clear. Try to stay alive for as long as you can without landing on a spike.

pages.title: Spooky Crazy House
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Search Halloween scenes for hidden objects in Spooky Crazy House. Look closely at the rooms and check details that might blend into the background. Find the objects one by one and see what else the house has hidden in its Halloween scenes.

pages.title: Arcade Golf
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Play ten holes in Arcade Golf and try to finish with as few strokes as possible. Look at the position of the hole and aim the ball before each shot. Adjust the next hit from where the ball lands until you’ve made it through the course.

pages.title: Funny Fast Fart
pages.creator: Cosmity
pages.description: Move from side to side in Funny Fast Fart to catch and return the fart past your rival. Score when it goes behind the other character, and watch for returns that come straight back at you. Reach 20 points to win the match and unlock a toilet character.

pages.title: Trend Girl
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Design a magazine cover in Trend Girl. Choose a model, put together her look, and pick a location for the photo. Once you’ve taken the picture, use it as the centerpiece of a front page that matches the style you want for the magazine.

pages.title: Breaking News With Ellie!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get a television reporter ready to go live in Breaking News With Ellie! Choose Ellie’s makeup first, then find a dress that goes with it. Try out the options and finish her look before she goes on camera with the breaking news.

pages.title: Flying Cheese
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Aim and launch a piece of cheese in Flying Cheese. The goal is to land it close enough for the hungry mouse to eat, so judge the angle before releasing the shot. Watch where it goes and adjust your next attempt if the cheese falls short.

pages.title: Puppy Ride
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Take a puppy on a physics-based car ride in Puppy Ride. Keep the car under control as it moves along the course, and try other vehicles to see how they handle. Use the available upgrades as you work through the game’s driving challenges.

pages.title: Annie Christmas Carol
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Annie get ready for the holidays in Annie Christmas Carol. Choose her Christmas outfit, then turn to the decorations for her home and tree. Try different pieces as you decide how you want the room to look for the celebration.

pages.title: Eliza Tailor Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design a dress in Eliza Tailor Shop. Choose a material, then pick the cut, colors, and patterns for the garment Eliza will make. Try different fabrics with the same design or change the shape until you’ve put together the dress you want.

pages.title: Equestria Girls First Day at School
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Get the girls ready for the start of school in Equestria Girls First Day at School. Look for the supplies they ask for, then put together outfits for the occasion. Finish each autumn look with shoes and accessories that suit the pieces you’ve chosen.
